description: Product stories, not an executable natural-language runner or observed-demand dataset.

queries.query: הראי לי את המפה בשנת 500 לפני הספירה.
queries.expectedView: Map with explicit BCE year and approximate source-interval territories
acceptance: Exact -500 entry excludes year zero; map remains draggable/pinchable.
Do not label the result maximum Persia extent or interpolate annual borders.
Unknown locations and source limitations remain visible.

queries.query: אני רוצה לשתף בדיוק את מה שאני רואה עכשיו.
queries.expectedView: Stable link to public year, lists, mode, map extent and selection
acceptance: Encode/decode preserves exact public view, including portrait aspect ratio and BCE.
Opening copied link restores view; copy success or fallback is visible.
Search text is included in the link; no private-library payload is added.

queries.query: הסוכנת שלי תבחר מפה, השוואה או ציר זמן ותציג לי אותם בתוך השיחה.
queries.expectedView: Interactive view in a verified supporting chat host, with readable link fallback
acceptance: Test one named host/version rather than infer support from MCP documentation.
Selection uses sourced public data with explicit uncertainty.
Unsupported host receives a usable static view/link; no fabricated inline rendering.

queries.query: אילו אירועי מסעות ומדע התרחשו בערך באותו זמן?
queries.expectedView: Two sourced series on one map with time context
acceptance: Current UI can select two lists and a year window; natural-language interpretation is not built.
Disclose the actual ±25-year range and that the sample catalog is not complete.
Identify series and link individual sources.

queries.expectedView: Authorized issue index with map points linking to original articles
acceptance: No issue content or private reference image is copied without rights.
Verify source archive navigation and consented issue scope.
Regional/uncertain locations are labeled; article discovery adds to existing navigation.

queries.query: השווי בין סיפור מסורתי לבין אירועים היסטוריים באותה תקופה.
queries.expectedView: Clearly separated tradition and historical evidence
acceptance: Do not invent a historical identification or exact date for tradition.
Show attributed sources, chronology uncertainty and independent claim types.
If dates cannot be aligned, explain the limit instead of plotting false precision.

queries.intent: Create a topic list from audio
queries.expectedView: Reviewed draft list with source/time references, not automatic publication
acceptance: Obtain access and rights for the specified source; do not claim ingestion is built.
Verify factual claims beyond speech transcription and label uncertain places/dates.
Draft requires content review before entering public catalog.

queries.query: הדפיסי את התצוגה בלי כל הכפתורים.
queries.expectedView: Print/image layout with year, legend, sources and attribution
acceptance: Preserve the chosen view and meaningful labels.
Check actual print/export pixels and attribution legibility.
Do not imply export currently exists.
